description:
位于桥北路的光华大戏院，是20年代本地最早出现的有声影院之一，也是华语片的首轮放映地。89岁的老居民符气敬忆述当年木椅、电扇、粪桶厕所的观影环境，以及上映《火烧红莲寺》、《黄飞鸿》等粤语片的盛况。虽已在80年代拆除，但其英文名“Jubilee Hall”仍留在莱佛士酒店中。 

Located along North Bridge Road, Jubilee Theatre was one of Singapore’s earliest sound cinemas in the 1920s and a key venue for first-run Chinese films. 
Mr. Foo, now 89, recalls wooden seats, noisy fans, bucket toilets, and packed screenings of classics like Burning of the Red Lotus Temple and Wong Fei Hung. 
Though demolished in the 1980s, its legacy lives on—Raffles Hotel adopted its English name for the new Jubilee Hall.
